description.zh:
待添加的加速域名，仅支持添加单个域名。

支持添加泛域名，以点号（.）开头，例如.example.com。
description.en:
The domain name to be accelerated. You can add only one domain name per request.

Wildcard domains are supported. A wildcard domain must start with a period (.), for example, `.example.com`.

description.zh:
计算服务类型。取值：
- **routine**：程序。
- **image**：镜像。
- **cloudFunction**：函数。
description.en:
The computing service type. Valid values:

- **routine**: Routine.

- **image**: Image.

- **cloudFunction**: Cloud function.

description.zh: 资源组ID。不传该参数时，系统自动补全默认资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group. If you omit this parameter, the system uses the ID of the default resource group.

description.zh:
加速区域。取值：

- **domestic**：仅中国内地。
- **overseas**：全球（不包含中国内地）。
- **global**：全球。

默认取值为**domestic**。
description.en:
The service scope. Valid values:

- **domestic**: Chinese mainland.

- **overseas**: Regions outside the Chinese mainland.

- **global**: Global.

Default value: **domestic**.
The tags to add to the domain. You can add up to 20 tags.

descriptions.zh:
- 创建域名之前，您必须先开通DCDN服务。具体操作，请参见[OpenDcdnService](~~OpenDcdnService~~)。
- 如果加速区域选择的是仅中国内地或者全球，则加速域名必须已完成备案。
- 当您首次将新域名添加至阿里云DCDN时，需按要求做域名归属权验证。具体操作，请参见[VerifyDcdnDomainOwner](~~VerifyDcdnDomainOwner~~)。
- 每次只能添加一个加速域名，每个用户默认最多可以添加50个域名，如果需要添加更多域名，您可以通过配额中心申请。
- 每个用户每小时最多调用100次。
descriptions.en:
- You must activate the DCDN service before you add a domain name. For more information, see [OpenDcdnService](~~OpenDcdnService~~).

- If the acceleration region is set to Chinese mainland only or Global, the accelerated domain must have an ICP filing.

- The first time you add a domain name to Alibaba Cloud DCDN, you must complete domain ownership verification. For more information, see [VerifyDcdnDomainOwner](~~VerifyDcdnDomainOwner~~).

- You can add only one accelerated domain at a time. By default, each user can add up to 50 domain names. To add more, request a quota increase in Quota Center.

- This operation is limited to 100 calls per user per hour.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn add-dcdn-domain --domain-name example.com --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --sources content_:_10.10.10.10_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80 --check-url www.example.com/test.html --scope domestic --top-level-domain yourTopLevelDomain --tag Value=value Key=env --function-type routine --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn AddDcdnDomain --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --CheckUrl 'www.example.com/test.html' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyuji4b6r400' --Scope domestic --DomainName 'example.com' --FunctionType routine --Tag.1.Value value --TopLevelDomain yourTopLevelDomain --Sources 'content_:_10.10.10.10_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80'
